 'Quit my job to be here': Sunderland fans revel in wet Poznan before Lech Poznan tie, gallery 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Sunderland supporters are enjoying themselves in Poznan before tonight’s Europa League group game with Lech Poznan, kick-off 5.45pm, with wet conditions failing to dampen spirits.
 According to Sunderland Echo, the outlet is in the city capturing the pre-match atmosphere and has published a gallery of travelling fans.
 OneFootball Videos
 The images show supporters congregating around the city and taking in the build-up ahead of the group game.
 Sunderland’s away following is in force as anticipation builds.
 The scenes capture the away-day mood in the hours before kick-off.
 Source: Sunderland Echo
